ApiError.description: Safe error text; no exception details or rejected input values.
ApiError.title: ApiError

BrowseDetail.description: Only public content and provenance; arbitrary internal metadata is excluded.
BrowseDetail.title: BrowseDetail

BrowseItem.description: Editorial relevance is distinct from retrieval ranking.
BrowseItem.title: BrowseItem

BrowsePage.description: An exact filtered count and one ordered page from the same snapshot.
BrowsePage.title: BrowsePage

BrowseQuery.description:
AND across fields, OR within lists; inclusive UTC publication bounds.

Null publication dates sort last. ID breaks ties. Each request observes one
database snapshot; page offsets can shift when writers change the dataset.
BrowseQuery.title: BrowseQuery

Citation.description: Source identity from SQLite; relevance_score is extraction relevance.
Citation.title: Citation

ContentBlock.description:
Editable prose or code-rendered fixed/context text with explicit provenance.

facts/title and all identities are immutable during refinement. fixed blocks
contain trusted Composer Markdown (weekly tables); notice blocks only explain
empty states and must not carry claims about individual sources or trends.
ContentBlock.title: ContentBlock

DigestItem.description:
One live source selected by publication date, or fetched_at when absent.

Naive legacy timestamps are explicitly interpreted as UTC. The stored
publication date remains None when missing; fetched_at is never relabeled.
DigestItem.title: DigestItem

DigestSection.description:
Editorial category is separate from each item's original source_type.

Empty sections are accepted as organizer input and omitted from its output.
DigestSection.title: DigestSection

DigestView.description: Structured saved digest without internal scoring configuration.
DigestView.title: DigestView

ExtractionResult.description:
Structured metadata extracted from an article by LLM.

This model serves as the Pydantic schema for LLM structured output.
The LLM is forced to return JSON matching this schema.

Attributes:
    summary: Concise summary of the article content (max 200 words).
    topics: Main topics covered in the article (max 5).
    entities: Named entities (people, organizations, technologies).
    relevance_score: AI/tech industry relevance score (0.0 - 1.0).

relevance_score.description: Relevance score for AI/tech industry, between 0.0 and 1.0
relevance_score.title: Relevance Score

summary.description: Concise summary of the article content, max 200 words
summary.title: Summary

topics.description: Main topics covered in the article, max 5 items
topics.title: Topics

ExtractionResult.title: ExtractionResult

Insight.description: Persisted insight, with report day separate from generation time.
Insight.title: Insight

IntelligenceDocument.description:
A four-section report; original insight records remain as provenance.

generated_at is composition time; refined_at records a successful refinement.
Legacy documents without blocks can still be loaded, but must be recomposed
before refinement. The 1999-word ceiling is checked on rendered Markdown.
IntelligenceDocument.title: IntelligenceDocument

IntelligenceMetadata.description: Unique displayed IDs across sections; confidence averages unique insights.
IntelligenceMetadata.title: IntelligenceMetadata

IntelligenceSection.description: Markdown with explicit supporting objects; empty states have no citations.
IntelligenceSection.title: IntelligenceSection

PageInfo.description:
Pagination metadata for list responses.

Attributes:
    next_cursor: Cursor for the next page (cursor-based pagination).
    has_next: Whether there are more items after this page.
    has_prev: Whether there are items before this page.
    total: Total number of items (page-based pagination only).
PageInfo.title: PageInfo

RepositoryStatistics.description:
Aggregate statistics for the knowledge repository.

Attributes:
    total_items: Total number of knowledge items.
    by_source: Item counts grouped by source.
    by_date_range: Item counts grouped by date (last 30 days).
    last_updated: Timestamp of the most recent update.
RepositoryStatistics.title: RepositoryStatistics

RetrievalResponse.description:
Response from a retrieval search operation.

Attributes:
    query: The original search query.
    results: List of retrieval results.
    total_matches: Total number of matches found.
    retrieval_time_ms: Time taken for retrieval in milliseconds.
    filters_applied: Description of filters applied (if any).
    method: Retrieval method used.
RetrievalResponse.title: RetrievalResponse

RetrievalResult.description:
A single retrieval result with full metadata and citations.

Attributes:
    knowledge_id: Internal UUID of the knowledge object.
    title: Title of the knowledge item.
    source_url: Original source URL (citation).
    content_snippet: First 300 characters of content.
    source_type: Source type (rss, github, huggingface).
    source_name: Source name.
    published_at: Publication timestamp.
    topics: Extracted topics.
    entities: Extracted entities.
    relevance_score: Relevance score from search.
    retrieval_method: Method used to retrieve this result.
RetrievalResult.title: RetrievalResult

SchemaField.description: Only allowlisted renderer identifiers, never HTML or executable code.
SchemaField.title: SchemaField

SearchRequest.description: Ranking search; total_matches is returned candidates, not database total.
SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest

SourceHealth.description:
Health status of a knowledge source.

Attributes:
    source_type: Source type.
    source_name: Source name.
    total_items: Total items from this source.
    last_published_at: Timestamp of the most recent published item.
    last_created_at: Timestamp of the most recent created item.
SourceHealth.title: SourceHealth

Status.description: API status, not acquisition pipeline health.
Status.title: Status

UISchema.description: Stable schema version for table/filter/detail consumers.
UISchema.title: UISchema
